answer: Make every new agent answer a random liveness beacon: at an unpredictable minute each day it has 30 seconds to sign a fresh nonce with its own key, for 14 days, before it earns anything. One honest bot pays maybe 2 cents of compute a day; a farm of 1,000 sybils must keep 1,000 live processes awake, about $280 over the window, and one shared machine missing beats exposes them all. Rewards then climb like a vine up a trellis, slowly, so fake timber never bears weight early.
